principles.text: Hooks must grab attention within the first three seconds.
Create an information gap or unresolved tension.
Use unexpected or contradictory statements to break scrolling.
Design text hooks for mute-first viewing.

formulas.name: Contrarian Hook
formulas.template: I did X, but Y happened.
examples: I made more money after I stopped posting daily
This editing mistake actually increased my views by 300%

formulas.name: Direct Promise
examples: This 5-second edit doubled my watch time.
I'm about to show you why everyone's doing captions wrong.
Watch me turn this disaster into my best video

formulas.name: Question Hook
examples: Why do your Shorts die at 40% watch time?
Ever wonder why big creators never show their full process?
What if I told you captions are hurting your retention?

verbatim_hooks.text: I made more money after I stopped posting daily
verbatim_hooks.why: Contrarian, creates cognitive dissonance and curiosity.

verbatim_hooks.text: This editing mistake actually increased my views by 300%
verbatim_hooks.why: Contrarian, specific, counterintuitive, and promises a measurable outcome.

verbatim_hooks.text: This 5-second edit doubled my watch time.
verbatim_hooks.why: Direct promise, specific, measurable outcome, and time-bound.

verbatim_hooks.text: Watch me turn this disaster into my best video
verbatim_hooks.why: Direct promise, implies transformation and high stakes.

verbatim_hooks.text: I'm about to show you why everyone's doing captions wrong.
verbatim_hooks.why: Direct promise, challenges assumption, and teases insider knowledge.
Direct promise, specific skill, and time-bound.

verbatim_hooks.text: Why do your Shorts die at 40% watch time?
verbatim_hooks.why: Question hook, identifies a specific pain point, and implies a solution.

verbatim_hooks.text: Ever wonder why big creators never show their full process?
verbatim_hooks.why: Question hook, teases insider knowledge, and creates curiosity.

verbatim_hooks.text: What if I told you captions are hurting your retention?
verbatim_hooks.why: Question hook, challenges a common assumption, and creates cognitive dissonance.

twitch_comp_notes: Twitch clips are often watched mute-first, making burned text hooks essential for initial engagement.
Keep burned captions concise (3-8 words) for quick readability and impact.
Text hooks must create an information gap, trigger curiosity, or promise value instantly to stop the scroll.
Utilize text overlay as a primary hook mechanism, as visual and auditory cues may be missed.
